entries.5128f76a0902869c: This is a business in which consolidated subsidiary Buffalo Food Service Co., Ltd. operates restaurants. It provides dining services as a franchisee of “Yakiniku Like,” operated by Yakiniku Like Co., Ltd., and “PISOLA,” operated by PISOLA Co., Ltd. As of March 31, 2026, the number of stores was 5 for “Yakiniku Like” and 5 for “PISOLA,” for a total of 10 stores. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,043 million.

entries.98a8bf232588c689: This business is one in which the company operates 15 stores in the southwestern part of Saitama Prefecture and northern Tokyo as a franchisee of “AUTOBACS,” which is operated by AUTOBACS SEVEN CO., LTD. It sells car accessories such as tires and wheels, car electronics, and oil and batteries to general consumers and provides installation services. It also provides vehicle inspection and maintenance certified under the designated automobile maintenance business, vehicle purchase and sales, and automobile insurance agency services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,662 million, making it the center of the group as a whole.
